flavorText.x-y: The quills on its head are usually soft. When it flexes them, the points become so hard and sharp that they can pierce rock.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: The quills on its head are usually soft. When it flexes them, the points become so hard and sharp that they can pierce rock.

flavorText.x-y: It relies on its sturdy shell to deflect predators’ attacks. It counterattacks with its sharp quills.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: It relies on its sturdy shell to deflect predators’ attacks. It counterattacks with its sharp quills.

flavorText.x-y: Its Tackle is forceful enough to flip a 50-ton tank. It shields its allies from danger with its own body.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Its Tackle is forceful enough to flip a 50-ton tank. It shields its allies from danger with its own body.

flavorText.x-y: Eating a twig fills it with energy, and its roomy ears give vent to air hotter than 390 degrees Fahrenheit.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Eating a twig fills it with energy, and its roomy ears give vent to air hotter than 390 degrees Fahrenheit.

flavorText.x-y: It has a twig stuck in its tail. With friction from its tail fur, it sets the twig on fire and launches into battle.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: It has a twig stuck in its tail. With friction from its tail fur, it sets the twig on fire and launches into battle.

flavorText.x-y: It gazes into the flame at the tip of its branch to achieve a focused state, which allows it to see into the future.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: It gazes into the flame at the tip of its branch to achieve a focused state, which allows it to see into the future.

flavorText.x-y: It secretes flexible bubbles from its chest and back. The bubbles reduce the damage it would otherwise take when attacked.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: It secretes flexible bubbles from its chest and back. The bubbles reduce the damage it would otherwise take when attacked.

flavorText.x-y: It can throw bubble-covered pebbles with precise control, hitting empty cans up to a hundred feet away.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: It can throw bubble-covered pebbles with precise control, hitting empty cans up to a hundred feet away.

flavorText.x-y: It creates throwing stars out of compressed water. When it spins them and throws them at high speed, these stars can split metal in two.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: It creates throwing stars out of compressed water. When it spins them and throws them at high speed, these stars can split metal in two.

flavorText.x-y: They use their large ears to dig burrows. They will dig the whole night through.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: They use their large ears to dig burrows. They will dig the whole night through.
flavorText.sword-shield: It excels at digging holes. Using its ears, it can dig a nest 33 feet deep in one night.

flavorText.x-y: With their powerful ears, they can heft boulders of a ton or more with ease. They can be a big help at construction sites.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: With their powerful ears, they can heft boulders of a ton or more with ease. They can be a big help at construction sites.
flavorText.sword-shield: With power equal to an excavator, it can dig through dense bedrock. It’s a huge help during tunnel construction.

flavorText.x-y: These friendly Pokémon send signals to one another with beautiful chirps and tail-feather movements.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: These friendly Pokémon send signals to one another with beautiful chirps and tail-feather movements.
flavorText.sun-moon: This amiable Pokémon is easy to train. But when battle is joined, it shows its ferocious side.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: While it’s an amiable Pokémon, if you touch it unexpectedly, it will heat up its body in an instant, and you’ll be burned.
flavorText.sword-shield: Its melodious cries are actually warnings. Fletchling will mercilessly peck at anything that enters its territory.

flavorText.x-y: From its beak, it expels embers that set the tall grass on fire. Then it pounces on the bewildered prey that pop out of the grass.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: From its beak, it expels embers that set the tall grass on fire. Then it pounces on the bewildered prey that pop out of the grass.
flavorText.sun-moon: From its beak, it fires embers at its prey. Once it has caught them, it grills them at high heat before feasting upon them.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: It scatters embers in the tall grass. Then bug Pokémon, frightened by the flames, come flying out, and Fletchinder gobbles them up.
flavorText.sword-shield: Fletchinder launches embers into the den of its prey. When the prey comes leaping out, Fletchinder’s sharp talons finish it off.

flavorText.x-y: In the fever of an exciting battle, it showers embers from the gaps between its feathers and takes to the air.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: In the fever of an exciting battle, it showers embers from the gaps between its feathers and takes to the air.
flavorText.sun-moon: Its favorite foods are Wingull and Pikipek. It attacks with a powerful kick and grasps them firmly in its talons.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: Its tough wings don’t allow fire to pass through them. A long time ago, firefighters’ outfits were made from Talonflame wings.
flavorText.sword-shield: Talonflame mainly preys upon other bird Pokémon. To intimidate opponents, it sends embers spewing from gaps between its feathers.

flavorText.x-y: When under attack from bird Pokémon, it spews a poisonous black powder that causes paralysis on contact.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: When under attack from bird Pokémon, it spews a poisonous black powder that causes paralysis on contact.

flavorText.x-y: It lives hidden within thicket shadows. When predators attack, it quickly bristles the fur covering its body in an effort to threaten them.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: It lives hidden within thicket shadows. When predators attack, it quickly bristles the fur covering its body in an effort to threaten them.

flavorText.x-y: Vivillon with many different patterns are found all over the world. These patterns are affected by the climate of their habitat.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Vivillon with many different patterns are found all over the world. These patterns are affected by the climate of their habitat.

flavorText.x-y: The stronger the opponent it faces, the more heat surges from its mane and the more power flows through its body.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: The stronger the opponent it faces, the more heat surges from its mane and the more power flows through its body.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: When they’re young, they live with a pride. Once they’re able to hunt prey on their own, they’re kicked out and have to make their own way.

flavorText.x-y: The male with the largest mane of fire is the leader of the pride.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: The male with the largest mane of fire is the leader of the pride.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: The males are usually lazy, but when attacked by a strong foe, a male will protect its friends with no regard for its own safety.

flavorText.x-y: It draws out and controls the hidden power of flowers. The flower Flabébé holds is most likely part of its body.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: It draws out and controls the hidden power of flowers. The flower Flabébé holds is most likely part of its body.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: It’s not safe without the power of a flower, but it will keep traveling around until it finds one with the color and shape it wants.

flavorText.x-y: It flutters around fields of flowers and cares for flowers that are starting to wilt. It draws out the hidden power of flowers to battle.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: It flutters around fields of flowers and cares for flowers that are starting to wilt. It draws out the hidden power of flowers to battle.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: It raises flowers and uses them as weapons. The more gorgeous the blossom, the more power it contains.

flavorText.x-y: It claims exquisite flower gardens as its territory, and it obtains power from basking in the energy emitted by flowering plants.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: It claims exquisite flower gardens as its territory, and it obtains power from basking in the energy emitted by flowering plants.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: It controls the flowers it grows. The petal blizzards that Florges triggers are overwhelming in their beauty and power.

flavorText.x-y: Thought to be one of the first Pokémon to live in harmony with humans, it has a placid disposition.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Thought to be one of the first Pokémon to live in harmony with humans, it has a placid disposition.

flavorText.x-y: It can tell how its Trainer is feeling by subtle shifts in the grip on its horns. This empathic sense lets them run as if one being.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: It can tell how its Trainer is feeling by subtle shifts in the grip on its horns. This empathic sense lets them run as if one being.

flavorText.x-y: It does its best to be taken seriously by its enemies, but its glare is not sufficiently intimidating. Chewing on a leaf is its trademark.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: It does its best to be taken seriously by its enemies, but its glare is not sufficiently intimidating. Chewing on a leaf is its trademark.
flavorText.sun-moon: It grows up imitating the behavior of Pangoro, which it looks up to as a leader.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: It follows Pangoro around like a henchman. When Pancham makes a big mistake, its leaf gets taken away.
flavorText.sword-shield: It chooses a Pangoro as its master and then imitates its master’s actions. This is how it learns to battle and hunt for prey.

flavorText.sun-moon: From the slight twitches of its bamboo leaf, it deduces its opponent’s movements. It’s eager to tussle but kindhearted toward its companions.
flavorText.x-y: Although it possesses a violent temperament, it won’t put up with bullying. It uses the leaf in its mouth to sense the movements of its enemies.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Although it possesses a violent temperament, it won’t put up with bullying. It uses the leaf in its mouth to sense the movements of its enemies.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: This rowdy Pokémon boasts great physical strength. Many Trainers are also smitten by its lively character.
flavorText.sword-shield: This Pokémon is quick to anger, and it has no problem using its prodigious strength to get its way. It lives for duels against Obstagoon.

flavorText.x-y: Trimming its fluffy fur not only makes it more elegant but also increases the swiftness of its movements.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Trimming its fluffy fur not only makes it more elegant but also increases the swiftness of its movements.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: There was an era when aristocrats would compete to see who could trim their Furfrou’s fur into the most exquisite style.

flavorText.x-y: The organ that emits its intense psychic power is sheltered by its ears to keep power from leaking out.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: The organ that emits its intense psychic power is sheltered by its ears to keep power from leaking out.
flavorText.sword-shield: Though Espurr’s expression never changes, behind that blank stare is an intense struggle to contain its devastating psychic power.

flavorText.x-y: When in danger, it raises its ears and releases enough psychic power to grind a 10-ton truck into dust.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: When in danger, it raises its ears and releases enough psychic power to grind a 10-ton truck into dust.
flavorText.sword-shield: Revealing the eyelike patterns on the insides of its ears will unleash its psychic powers. It normally keeps the patterns hidden, however.

flavorText.x-y: Apparently this Pokémon is born when a departed spirit inhabits a sword. It attaches itself to people and drinks their life force.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Apparently this Pokémon is born when a departed spirit inhabits a sword. It attaches itself to people and drinks their life force.
flavorText.sword-shield: Honedge’s soul once belonged to a person who was killed a long time ago by the sword that makes up Honedge’s body.

flavorText.x-y: When Honedge evolves, it divides into two swords, which cooperate via telepathy to coordinate attacks and slash their enemies to ribbons.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: When Honedge evolves, it divides into two swords, which cooperate via telepathy to coordinate attacks and slash their enemies to ribbons.
flavorText.sword-shield: Honedge evolves into twins. The two blades rub together to emit a metallic sound that unnerves opponents.

flavorText.x-y: Generations of kings were attended by these Pokémon, which used their spectral power to manipulate and control people and Pokémon.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Generations of kings were attended by these Pokémon, which used their spectral power to manipulate and control people and Pokémon.
flavorText.sword-shield: In this defensive stance, Aegislash uses its steel body and a force field of spectral power to reduce the damage of any attack.

flavorText.x-y: It emits a scent that enraptures those who smell it. This fragrance changes depending on what it has eaten.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: It emits a scent that enraptures those who smell it. This fragrance changes depending on what it has eaten.
flavorText.sword-shield: A scent pouch within this Pokémon’s body allows it to create various scents. A change in its diet will alter the fragrance it produces.

flavorText.x-y: It devises various scents, pleasant and unpleasant, and emits scents that its enemies dislike in order to gain an edge in battle.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: It devises various scents, pleasant and unpleasant, and emits scents that its enemies dislike in order to gain an edge in battle.
flavorText.sword-shield: The scent that constantly emits from its fur is so powerful that this Pokémon’s companions will eventually lose their sense of smell.

flavorText.x-y: To entangle its opponents in battle, it extrudes white threads as sweet and sticky as cotton candy.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: To entangle its opponents in battle, it extrudes white threads as sweet and sticky as cotton candy.
flavorText.sword-shield: It eats its own weight in sugar every day. If it doesn’t get enough sugar, it becomes incredibly grumpy.

flavorText.x-y: It can distinguish the faintest of scents. It puts its sensitive sense of smell to use by helping pastry chefs in their work.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: It can distinguish the faintest of scents. It puts its sensitive sense of smell to use by helping pastry chefs in their work.
flavorText.sword-shield: By taking in a person’s scent, it can sniff out their mental and physical condition. It’s hoped that this skill will have many medical applications.

flavorText.x-y: Opponents who stare at the flashing of the light-emitting spots on its body become dazed and lose their will to fight.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Opponents who stare at the flashing of the light-emitting spots on its body become dazed and lose their will to fight.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: It draws prey near with its blinking lights and then wraps them up in its long tentacles and holds them in place.
flavorText.sword-shield: It spins while making its luminescent spots flash. These spots allow it to communicate with others by using different patterns of light.

flavorText.x-y: It wields the most compelling hypnotic powers of any Pokémon, and it forces others to do whatever it wants.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: It wields the most compelling hypnotic powers of any Pokémon, and it forces others to do whatever it wants.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: When it comes to strong hypnosis, there’s an endless number of people who utilize Malamar for their nefarious deeds.
flavorText.sword-shield: Gazing at its luminescent spots will quickly induce a hypnotic state, putting the observer under Malamar’s control.

flavorText.x-y: Two Binacle live together on one rock. When they fight, one of them will move to a different rock.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Two Binacle live together on one rock. When they fight, one of them will move to a different rock.
flavorText.sword-shield: After two Binacle find a suitably sized rock, they adhere themselves to it and live together. They cooperate to gather food during high tide.

flavorText.x-y: When they evolve, two Binacle multiply into seven. They fight with the power of seven Binacle.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: When they evolve, two Binacle multiply into seven. They fight with the power of seven Binacle.
flavorText.sword-shield: Seven Binacle come together to form one Barbaracle. The Binacle that serves as the head gives orders to those serving as the limbs.

flavorText.x-y: Camouflaged as rotten kelp, they spray liquid poison on prey that approaches unawares and then finish it off.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Camouflaged as rotten kelp, they spray liquid poison on prey that approaches unawares and then finish it off.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: It vanishes into seaweed and remains perfectly still to avoid attacks from large Pokémon. Rotten seaweed is its main food source.
flavorText.sword-shield: It drifts in the ocean, blending in with floating seaweed. When other Pokémon come to feast on the seaweed, Skrelp feasts on them instead.

flavorText.x-y: Their poison is strong enough to eat through the hull of a tanker, and they spit it indiscriminately at anything that enters their territory.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Their poison is strong enough to eat through the hull of a tanker, and they spit it indiscriminately at anything that enters their territory.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: This vicious Pokémon sprays a poisonous liquid on opponents that come near. For whatever reason, it gets along really well with Dhelmise.
flavorText.sword-shield: Dragalge uses a poisonous liquid capable of corroding metal to send tankers that enter its territory to the bottom of the sea.

flavorText.x-y: They knock down flying prey by firing compressed water from their massive claws like shooting a pistol.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: They knock down flying prey by firing compressed water from their massive claws like shooting a pistol.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: Its claws occasionally fall off, and it keeps a low profile until they grow back. The meat of its claws is so delicious!
flavorText.sword-shield: Clauncher’s claws can fall off during battle, but they’ll regenerate. The meat inside the claws is popular as a delicacy in Galar.

flavorText.x-y: Their enormous claws launch cannonballs of water powerful enough to pierce tanker hulls.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Their enormous claws launch cannonballs of water powerful enough to pierce tanker hulls.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: It compresses the water it has sucked up and then projects it with enough power to punch a hole right through a thick sheet of iron.
flavorText.sword-shield: After using the feelers on its oversized claw to detect the location of prey, Clawitzer launches a cannonball of water at its target.

flavorText.x-y: They make their home in deserts. They can generate their energy from basking in the sun, so eating food is not a requirement.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: They make their home in deserts. They can generate their energy from basking in the sun, so eating food is not a requirement.
flavorText.sword-shield: When spread, the frills on its head act like solar panels, generating the power behind this Pokémon’s electric moves.

flavorText.x-y: They flare their frills and generate energy. A single Heliolisk can generate sufficient electricity to power a skyscraper.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: They flare their frills and generate energy. A single Heliolisk can generate sufficient electricity to power a skyscraper.
flavorText.sword-shield: A now-vanished desert culture treasured these Pokémon. Appropriately, when Heliolisk came to the Galar region, treasure came with them.

flavorText.x-y: This Pokémon was restored from a fossil. If something happens that it doesn’t like, it throws a tantrum and runs wild.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: This Pokémon was restored from a fossil. If something happens that it doesn’t like, it throws a tantrum and runs wild.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: Its large jaw has incredible destructive power. Some theories suggest that its restored form is different from its form of long ago.
flavorText.sword-shield: This is an ancient Pokémon, revived in modern times. It has a violent disposition, and it’ll tear apart anything it gets between its hefty jaws.

flavorText.x-y: Thanks to its gargantuan jaws, which could shred thick metal plates as if they were paper, it was invincible in the ancient world it once inhabited.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Thanks to its gargantuan jaws, which could shred thick metal plates as if they were paper, it was invincible in the ancient world it once inhabited.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: Complete restoration is impossible, allowing room for theories that its entire body was once covered in a feather-like coat.
flavorText.sword-shield: This Pokémon is from about 100,000,000 years ago. It has the presence of a king, vicious but magnificent.

flavorText.x-y: This ancient Pokémon was restored from part of its body that had been frozen in ice for over 100 million years.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: This ancient Pokémon was restored from part of its body that had been frozen in ice for over 100 million years.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: It lived in cold areas in ancient times. It’s said that when Amaura whinnies, auroras appear in the night sky.
flavorText.sword-shield: This Pokémon was successfully restored from a fossil. In the past, it lived with others of its kind in cold lands where there were fewer predators.

flavorText.x-y: The diamond-shaped crystals on its body expel air as cold as -240 degrees Fahrenheit, surrounding its enemies and encasing them in ice.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: The diamond-shaped crystals on its body expel air as cold as -240 degrees Fahrenheit, surrounding its enemies and encasing them in ice.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: An Aurorus was found frozen solid within a glacier, just as it appeared long ago, which became quite a big event in the news.
flavorText.sword-shield: Aurorus was restored from a fossil. It’s said that when this Pokémon howls, auroras appear in the night sky.

flavorText.x-y: It sends a soothing aura from its ribbonlike feelers to calm fights.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: It sends a soothing aura from its ribbonlike feelers to calm fights.
flavorText.sun-moon: Its ribbonlike feelers give off an aura that weakens hostility in its prey, causing them to let down their guard. Then it attacks.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: Once a fight breaks out, it will unflinchingly charge at dragon Pokémon that are many times larger than itself.
flavorText.sword-shield: By releasing enmity-erasing waves from its ribbonlike feelers, Sylveon stops any conflict.
flavorText.legends-arceus: It emits a soothing aura from its ribbon-shaped organs. It wraps these appendages around quarrelers to instantly restore calm to the situation.

flavorText.x-y: Although its body is small, its proficient fighting skills enable it to keep up with big bruisers like Machamp and Hariyama.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Although its body is small, its proficient fighting skills enable it to keep up with big bruisers like Machamp and Hariyama.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: It overwhelms opponents with quick moves, but sometimes it showboats for too long when it’s using a special move and gets itself into a pinch.
flavorText.sword-shield: It drives its opponents to exhaustion with its agile maneuvers, then ends the fight with a flashy finishing move.

flavorText.x-y: Its whiskers serve as antennas. By sending and receiving electrical waves, it can communicate with others over vast distances.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Its whiskers serve as antennas. By sending and receiving electrical waves, it can communicate with others over vast distances.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: It sneaks into people’s homes and steals electricity from their outlets. When your electric bill seems off, it’s the handiwork of this rascal.
flavorText.sword-shield: A Dedenne’s whiskers pick up electrical waves other Dedenne send out. These Pokémon share locations of food or electricity with one another.

flavorText.x-y: Born from the temperatures and pressures deep underground, it fires beams from the stone in its head.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Born from the temperatures and pressures deep underground, it fires beams from the stone in its head.
flavorText.sun-moon: Born from the high temperatures and pressures deep underground, it defends itself by firing beams from the jewel part of its body.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: Some say that deep beneath the surface of the world, a pack of Carbink live with their queen in a kingdom of jewels.
flavorText.sword-shield: When beset by attackers, Carbink wipes them all out by firing high-energy beams from the gems embedded in its body.

flavorText.x-y: The weakest Dragon-type Pokémon, it lives in damp, shady places, so its body doesn’t dry out.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: The weakest Dragon-type Pokémon, it lives in damp, shady places, so its body doesn’t dry out.
flavorText.sun-moon: The weakest of all Dragon-type Pokémon, it’s unable to breathe if its skin dries out, so it sticks to shady places.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: It uses its horns to check out its surroundings. They’re very sensitive, so if you grab them, it will feel a strong shock and be unable to move.
flavorText.sword-shield: Because most of its body is water, it will dry up if the weather becomes too arid. It’s considered the weakest dragon Pokémon.
flavorText.legends-arceus: Goomy hides away in the shade of trees, where it's nice and humid. If the slime coating its body dries out, the Pokémon instantly becomes lethargic.

flavorText.x-y: It drives away opponents by excreting a sticky liquid that can dissolve anything. Its eyes devolved, so it can’t see anything.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: It drives away opponents by excreting a sticky liquid that can dissolve anything. Its eyes devolved, so it can’t see anything.
flavorText.sun-moon: It has trouble drawing a line between friends and food. It will calmly try to melt and eat even those it gets along well with.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: It crawls along sluggishly. The swirly protrusion on its back is filled with its brain and other organs.
flavorText.sword-shield: Although this Pokémon isn’t very strong, its body is coated in a caustic slime that can melt through anything, so predators steer clear of it.
flavorText.legends-arceus: A creature given to melancholy. I suspect its metallic shell developed as a result of the mucus on its skin reacting with the iron in Hisui's water.

flavorText.x-y: This very friendly Dragon-type Pokémon will hug its beloved Trainer, leaving that Trainer covered in sticky slime.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: This very friendly Dragon-type Pokémon will hug its beloved Trainer, leaving that Trainer covered in sticky slime.
flavorText.sun-moon: An amazingly friendly Pokémon, but if left to itself, loneliness overcomes it, and it oozes gooey tears.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: It’s very friendly toward people. If you grow close to it, Goodra will hug you with its sticky, slime-covered body. Don’t get mad.
flavorText.sword-shield: Sometimes it misunderstands instructions and appears dazed or bewildered. Many Trainers don’t mind, finding this behavior to be adorable.
flavorText.legends-arceus: Able to freely control the hardness of its metallic shell. It loathes solitude and is extremely clingy—it will fume and run riot if those dearest to it ever leave its side.

flavorText.x-y: These key collectors threaten any attackers by fiercely jingling their keys at them.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: These key collectors threaten any attackers by fiercely jingling their keys at them.
flavorText.sun-moon: This even-tempered Pokémon has a habit of collecting keys. It will sneak into people’s homes to steal their keys.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: Although it’s unclear why it collects keys, giving it a key makes Klefki very happy. However, it apparently only likes master keys.
flavorText.sword-shield: This Pokémon is constantly collecting keys. Entrust a Klefki with important keys, and the Pokémon will protect them no matter what.

flavorText.x-y: These Pokémon are created when spirits possess rotten tree stumps. They prefer to live in abandoned forests.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: These Pokémon are created when spirits possess rotten tree stumps. They prefer to live in abandoned forests.
flavorText.sun-moon: These Pokémon are stumps possessed by the spirits of children who died in the forest. Their cries sound like eerie screams.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: By imitating the voice of a child, it causes people to get hopelessly lost deep in the forest. It’s trying to make friends with them.
flavorText.sword-shield: After a lost child perished in the forest, their spirit possessed a tree stump, causing the spirit’s rebirth as this Pokémon.

flavorText.x-y: It can control trees at will. It will trap people who harm the forest, so they can never leave.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: It can control trees at will. It will trap people who harm the forest, so they can never leave.
flavorText.sun-moon: This Pokémon is said to devour anyone daring to ravage the forest. To the creatures dwelling in the forest, it offers great kindness.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: It’s feared as a ghost of the forest. Lumberjacks bring along Fire types, which Trevenant hates, when they enter the forest.
flavorText.sword-shield: People fear it due to a belief that it devours any who try to cut down trees in its forest, but to the Pokémon it shares its woods with, it’s kind.

flavorText.x-y: The pumpkin body is inhabited by a spirit trapped in this world. As the sun sets, it becomes restless and active.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: The pumpkin body is inhabited by a spirit trapped in this world. As the sun sets, it becomes restless and active.
flavorText.sword-shield: Spirits that wander this world are placed into Pumpkaboo’s body. They’re then moved on to the afterlife.

flavorText.x-y: Singing in eerie voices, they wander town streets on the night of the new moon. Anyone who hears their song is cursed.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Singing in eerie voices, they wander town streets on the night of the new moon. Anyone who hears their song is cursed.
flavorText.sword-shield: Eerie cries emanate from its body in the dead of night. The sounds are said to be the wails of spirits who are suffering in the afterlife.

flavorText.x-y: It blocks opponents’ attacks with the ice that shields its body. It uses cold air to repair any cracks with new ice.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: It blocks opponents’ attacks with the ice that shields its body. It uses cold air to repair any cracks with new ice.
flavorText.sword-shield: They chill the air around them to −150 degrees Fahrenheit, freezing the water in the air into ice that they use as armor.
flavorText.legends-arceus: Lives on mountains blanketed in perennial snow. It freezes water vapor in the air to make the ice helmet that it dons for defense.

flavorText.x-y: Its ice-covered body is as hard as steel. Its cumbersome frame crushes anything that stands in its way.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Its ice-covered body is as hard as steel. Its cumbersome frame crushes anything that stands in its way.
flavorText.sword-shield: At high latitudes, this Pokémon can be found with clusters of Bergmite on its back as it swims among the icebergs.
flavorText.legends-arceus: The armor of ice covering its lower jaw puts steel to shame and can shatter rocks with ease. This Pokémon barrels along steep mountain paths, cleaving through the deep snow.

flavorText.x-y: They live in pitch-black caves. Their enormous ears can emit ultrasonic waves of 200,000 hertz.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: They live in pitch-black caves. Their enormous ears can emit ultrasonic waves of 200,000 hertz.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: Fruits are its favorite foods. This gourmet carefully picks out just the ripe ones using its sonar.
flavorText.sword-shield: After nightfall, they emerge from the caves they nest in during the day. Using their ultrasonic waves, they go on the hunt for ripened fruit.

flavorText.x-y: They fly around on moonless nights and attack careless prey. Nothing can beat them in a battle in the dark.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: They fly around on moonless nights and attack careless prey. Nothing can beat them in a battle in the dark.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: Although it has a violent disposition, if you give it a nice ripe fruit that it loves, Noivern will suddenly become tame.
flavorText.sword-shield: Aggressive and cruel, this Pokémon will ruthlessly torment enemies that are helpless in the dark.

flavorText.x-y: Legends say it can share eternal life. It slept for a thousand years in the form of a tree before its revival.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: Legends say it can share eternal life. It slept for a thousand years in the form of a tree before its revival.

flavorText.x-y: When this legendary Pokémon’s wings and tail feathers spread wide and glow red, it absorbs the life force of living creatures.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: When this legendary Pokémon’s wings and tail feathers spread wide and glow red, it absorbs the life force of living creatures.

flavorText.x-y: When the Kalos region’s ecosystem falls into disarray, it appears and reveals its secret power.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: When the Kalos region’s ecosystem falls into disarray, it appears and reveals its secret power.
flavorText.sun-moon: This is Zygarde’s form when it has gathered 50% of its cells. It wipes out all those who oppose it, showing not a shred of mercy.
flavorText.ultra-sun-ultra-moon: This is Zygarde’s form when about half of its pieces have been assembled. It plays the role of monitoring the ecosystem.

flavorText.x-y: A sudden transformation of Carbink, its pink, glimmering body is said to be the loveliest sight in the whole world.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: A sudden transformation of Carbink, its pink, glimmering body is said to be the loveliest sight in the whole world.

flavorText.x-y: This troublemaker sends anything and everything to faraway places using its loop, which can warp space.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: In its true form, it possess a huge amount of power. Legends of its avarice tell how it once carried off an entire castle to gain the treasure hidden within.

flavorText.x-y: It lets out billows of steam and disappears into the dense fog. It’s said to live in mountains where humans do not tread.
flavorText.omega-ruby-alpha-sapphire: It lets out billows of steam and disappears into the dense fog. It’s said to live in mountains where humans do not tread.
